title: Beyond Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) Accelerators: Directed Evidence for Adaptive Sustainability Portfolios
abstract: arXiv:2601.20875v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Governments and development partners often seek Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) "accelerators" whose progress can propagate gains across human well-being, institutions, resources, and environmental priorities. Such claims require evidence on direction, timing, robustness, and trade-offs, not only network connectivity. We map directed SDG interdependence using a balanced panel of 114 countries observed annually from 2000 to 2024. Because the goal series are persistent, trending, and cross-sectionally dependent, we combine Dumitrescu-Hurlin panel Granger non-causality tests on first-differenced series with false-discovery control across 272 directed goal pairs, and panel local projections with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors for 31 theory-derived indicator linkages. We find 84 directed linkages after correction: 40 synergies and 44 trade-offs. This dense structure does not support a universal accelerator. Driver-receiver rankin

translated_title: 超越可持续发展目标（SDG）加速器：面向适应性可持续发展组合的定向证据
translated_abstract: 政府和发展伙伴常常寻求可持续发展目标（SDG）“加速器”，希望其进展能将收益传播至人类福祉、制度、资源和环境优先事项等各领域。这类主张需要关于方向、时机、稳健性和权衡的证据，而不仅仅是网络连通性。我们利用2000年至2024年间对114个国家进行年度观测的平衡面板数据，绘制了定向SDG相互依赖关系。由于目标序列具有持续性、趋势性和横截面依赖性，我们将针对一阶差分序列的Dumitrescu-Hurlin面板格兰杰非因果检验与覆盖272个定向目标配对的错误发现控制相结合，并采用带Driscoll-Kraay标准误的面板局部投影法分析31个基于理论推导的指标联系。校正后我们发现84个定向联系：40个协同效应和44个权衡关系。这一密集结构不支持存在普适性加速器。驱动-接收排名（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究基于114个国家2000至2024年的面板数据，结合面板格兰杰因果检验与局部投影方法，识别出84个定向SDG联系（40个协同、44个权衡），证明不存在普适的SDG加速器，并主张依据定向因果证据构建适应性的可持续发展政策组合。
en_tdlr: Using panel Granger causality tests and local projections on data from 114 countries (2000–2024), this study identifies 84 directed SDG linkages (40 synergies and 44 trade-offs), demonstrating that no universal SDG accelerator exists and advocating adaptive sustainability portfolios grounded in directed causal evidence.
